reason: Chrome needs the tts permission for chrome.tts; Firefox doesn't know it and uses the Web Speech API instead (#44).
Chrome runs background.service_worker; Firefox ignores it and runs the same file from background.scripts (#43).

data_collection_permissions needs Firefox for Android 142, while the desktop minimum is 140 (#43). The AMO listing is desktop only (#52), so this has no effect; to support Android, add gecko_android.strict_min_version 142.0 and remove this entry.
